name: dropdown
title: Dropdown
purpose: Render a compact anchored panel with configurable width and geometry for a small, consumer-defined group of links or actions.
accessibility: Keeps its consumer-provided content in the document flow for keyboard navigation.
Marks a closed panel aria-hidden and prevents pointer interaction.
Consumers own trigger semantics, focus management, and any menu role appropriate to their content.
commonMistakes: Using Dropdown as a standalone trigger instead of placing it in a relative parent.
Using a fixed start or end alignment when the trigger can approach the opposite viewport edge; use auto instead.
Applying menu roles to normal navigation links.
Filling a compact dropdown with an unstructured large inventory.
